metadata.purpose: Structured compile-fix and code-review learning log for Gemma 4.

rules.rule: Entries must be factual and based on actual Claude review, compiler output, test output, or Revit smoke-test evidence.
Do not store secrets, credentials, full proprietary files, irrelevant source dumps, or unrelated chat content.
Prefer minimal code snippets that isolate the mistake and the correction.
Each entry must include a reusable lesson suitable for future RAG retrieval.
Claude reviews and appends entries; Gemma drafts entries after correction turns.

learning_entry.task: Draft QuickDimensionWallMidRunProbe.cs models for the Session 2.7 log-only mid-run experiment.
learning_entry.mistake: First draft invented enum QuickDimensionWallMidRunRelation { None, Intersecting, Parallel, Coincident } and a result model with Distance/Relation/IsValid, ignoring the explicit contract.
learning_entry.root_cause: Generated generic geometry-relation names from priors instead of using the exact enum values and fields dictated by the architect's spec.
learning_entry.correction: Re-issued with exact required enum values (Ignored, EndJoinOnly, GeometryJoinOnly, MidRunCrossing, NonJoinedProximity, ParallelNonJoined) and the exact provenance/evidence fields; Gemma produced the correct enum + minimal result stub, Claude assembled the full value models.
learning_entry.lesson: When a spec lists exact enum members and model fields, reproduce them verbatim. Never substitute generic domain vocabulary for a contract-specified name set.
learning_entry.notes: Larger service-file generations timed out on the 12B QAT model (60s MCP limit); Claude authored the service integration glue from Gemma's verified helper bodies, per the compile-fix/integration clause of the workflow.
